🎬 The Untouchables (1987)

The Untouchables follows federal agent Eliot Ness, who arrives in 1930s Chicago determined to bring down the powerful crime empire of notorious gangster Al Capone during the Prohibition era. With corruption spreading throughout the city and many police officers secretly working for Capone, Ness struggles to find people he can trust. He eventually forms a small team of honest lawmen, including experienced Irish-American officer Jim Malone, determined rookie George Stone, and accountant Oscar Wallace. Together, they launch a dangerous campaign against organized crime, facing violent confrontations, betrayal, and deadly consequences as they attempt to bring Capone to justice. Starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Robert De Niro, and Andy Garcia, the film delivers intense action, suspense, and unforgettable performances while exploring courage, loyalty, corruption, and the fight for justice.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Thriller • Action

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 59m • R

🎥 Director: Brian De Palma

✍️ Writer: David Mamet

🏆 Awards: Sean Connery won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Untouchables is a 1987 American crime film directed by Brian De Palma, produced by Art Linson and written by David Mamet. It stars Kevin Costner, Charles Martin Smith, Andy García, Robert De Niro and Sean Connery. Set in 1930 Chicago, the film follows Eliot Ness (Costner) as he forms the Untouchables team to bring Al Capone (De Niro) to justice during Prohibition. It is the fourth film on which De Niro and De Palma collaborated, after Greetings (1968, De Niro's first lead in a feature role), The Wedding Party (1969) and Hi, Mom! (1970).
